caption: The drawing depicts a stylized figure standing on a multicolored pedestal composed of horizontal bands in pink, blue, and gray, with symmetrical green and yellow leaf-like shapes extending from the base. The figure wears a long, flowing robe adorned with alternating bands of blue and turquoise, each decorated with yellow teardrop or oval patterns and small white dots. The robe is outlined with a scalloped yellow edge, and underneath is a reddish-pink garment. The hands of the figure are pressed together in front of the chest. The figure's face is light in color, with simple, soft facial features, and brown hair parted in the center and tucked around the shoulders. Surrounding the head is a large circular halo, with a red inner ring and a green outer border, from which radiate alternating straight black lines and pointed teal rays, each tipped with a small yellow circle. The figure stands upon a geometric, stair-stepped platform rendered in pale blue with pink and gray borders. The background is plain and uncolored, enhancing the visibility of the central figure and its vivid hues.
title: New Mexico, "Bulto", Polychromed Wooden Figure
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
